camel_example: aliyun r-kvstore DescribeInstances --region cn-hangzhou --ArchitectureType standard --Tag.1.Key '存储类型' --EngineVersion '4.0' --PageSize 30 --ZoneId 'cn-hongkong-b' --ResourceGroupId 'rg-acfmyiu4ekp0000' --EditionType Enterprise --VSwitchId 'vsw-bp1e7clcw529l773d0000' --InstanceClass 'redis.master.small.default' --Expired false --VpcId 'vpc-bp1nme44gek34slfc0000' --PageNumber 1 --PrivateIp '172.16.49.000' --InstanceStatus Normal --ChargeType PostPaid --NetworkType CLASSIC --NodeType MASTER_SLAVE --Tag.1.Value '开发' --SearchKey apitest --GlobalInstance true --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --InstanceIds 'r-bp1zxszhcgatnx0000' --InstanceType Redis
description_en: Queries information about one or more ApsaraDB for Tair (Redis® OSS-Compatible) database instances
description_zh: 查询一个或多个云数据库 Tair（兼容 Redis）实例的信息
kebab_example: aliyun r-kvstore describe-instances --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --instance-ids r-bp1zxszhcgatnx0000 --instance-status Normal --charge-type PostPaid --network-type CLASSIC --engine-version 4.0 --instance-class redis.master.small.default --vpc-id vpc-bp1nme44gek34slfc0000 --vswitch-id vsw-bp1e7clcw529l773d0000 --page-number 1 --page-size 30 --instance-type Redis --search-key apitest --architecture-type standard --expired false --zone-id cn-hongkong-b --resource-group-id rg-acfmyiu4ekp0000 --global-instance true --edition-type Enterprise --private-ip 172.16.49.000 --tag Value=开发 Key=存储类型 --node-type MASTER_SLAVE --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeInstances

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the instance.

If you specify the Tag parameter in the request, you must also specify this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
实例所属的地域ID。

调用本接口时，如果传入了Tag参数，则本参数必须传入
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The IDs of the instances that you want to query.
To specify multiple instance IDs, separate them with commas (,). You can specify up to 30 instance IDs in a single request
parameters.help_zh:
需要查询的实例ID。
如需传入多个实例ID时，使用英文逗号（,）分隔实例ID，最多一个请求传入 30 个实例ID
parameters.name: instance_ids

parameters.help_en:
The instance status. Valid values:
Normal: The instance is normal.
Creating: The instance is being created.
Changing: The instance is being modified.
Inactive: The instance is disabled.
Flushing: The instance is being purged.
Released: The instance is released.
Transforming: The instance is being transformed.
Migrating: The instance is being migrated.
BackupRecovering: The instance is being restored from a backup.
MinorVersionUpgrading: A minor version update is in progress.
NetworkModifying: The network configuration is being changed.
SSLModifying: The SSL configuration is being changed.
MajorVersionUpgrading: A major engine version upgrade is in progress. The instance can be accessed as expected.

For more information about instance statuses, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/200740.html
parameters.help_zh:
实例状态，取值：
Normal：正常。
Creating：创建中。
Changing：修改中。
Inactive：被禁用。
Flushing：清除中。
Released：已释放。
Transforming：转换中。
Migrating：迁移中。
BackupRecovering：备份恢复中。
MinorVersionUpgrading：小版本升级中。
NetworkModifying：网络变更中。
SSLModifying：SSL变更中。
MajorVersionUpgrading：大版本升级中，可正常访问。

更多实例状态及详细信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/200740.html
parameters.name: instance_status

parameters.help_en:
The billing method. Valid values:
PrePaid: subscription.
PostPaid: pay-as-you-go
parameters.help_zh:
付费类型，取值：
PrePaid：预付费，即包年包月。
PostPaid：后付费，即按量付费
parameters.name: charge_type

parameters.help_en:
The network type. Valid values:
CLASSIC: classic network.
VPC: virtual private cloud (VPC)
parameters.help_zh:
网络类型，取值：
CLASSIC：经典网络。
VPC：专有网络
parameters.name: network_type

parameters.help_zh: 实例兼容Redis的版本，取值：2.8、4.0、5.0、6.0或7.0
parameters.name: engine_version

parameters.help_zh: 实例列表的页码，起始值为1，默认值为1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of entries per page. Maximum value: 50. Default value: 30
parameters.help_zh: 每页最多可显示的行数，最大值为50，默认值为30

parameters.help_zh: 支持模糊搜索实例名称或实例ID

cluster: Cluster Edition.

架构类型，取值：

The expiration status of the instance. Valid values:

true: The instance has expired.
false: The instance has not expired

实例的过期状态，取值：

true：已过期。
false：未过期

parameters.help_en:
The resource group ID.

parameters.help_zh:
资源组ID。
您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/158855.html接口或通过控制台获取资源组ID列表。相关操作，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/151181.html

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to filter out child instances of distributed instances from the returned instance list. Valid values:
true: Only child instance information is returned.
false: Child instance information is not returned
parameters.help_zh:
返回的实例列表中，是否过滤分布式实例中的子实例，取值：
true：只返回子实例信息。
false：不返回子实例信息
parameters.name: global_instance

parameters.help_en:
The edition type. Valid values:
Community: Redis Community Edition.
Enterprise: Tair Enterprise Edition
parameters.help_zh:
实例类型，取值：
Community：Redis开源版。
Enterprise：Tair企业版

parameters.help_zh: 专有网络IP地址

fields.help_zh: 标签键的值，与Tag Key组成标签的键值对
fields.name: value

fields.help_en:
The key of the tag. The tag key and tag value form a key-value pair.
You can specify up to 5 tag key-value pairs at a time
fields.help_zh:
标签的键，与Tag Value组成标签的键值对。
单次最多支持传入5组标签的键值对
fields.name: key

parameters.help_zh: 实例的标签信息

parameters.help_en:
The node type. Valid values:
MASTER_SLAVE: high availability (dual-replica)
STAND_ALONE: single replica
double: dual-replica
single: single replica
For cloud-native instances, select MASTER_SLAVE or STAND_ALONE. For classic instances, select double or single
parameters.help_zh:
节点类型，取值：
MASTER_SLAVE：高可用（双副本）
STAND_ALONE：单副本
double：双副本
single：单副本
云原生版实例请选择MASTER_SLAVE或STAND_ALONE，经典版实例请选择double或single
parameters.name: node_type

ArchitectureType.description_en:
The architecture type. Valid values:
cluster: Cluster Edition.
standard: Standard Edition.
rwsplit: read/write splitting.
NULL: all types. This is the default value

架构类型，返回值：
cluster：集群版。
standard：标准版。
rwsplit：读写分离版。
NULL：所有类型，默认值。

Bandwidth.description_en: The bandwidth of the instance. Unit: MB/s

The billing method. Valid values:
PrePaid: subscription.
PostPaid: pay-as-you-go
ChargeType.description_zh:
付费类型，返回值：
PrePaid：预付费。
PostPaid：后付费

CloudType.description_zh: 仅云盒实例显示该参数

ComputingType.description_en:
The computing type of the instance. Valid values:

Ecs: cloud-native.
Machine: physical machine
ComputingType.description_zh:
实例计算类型，返回值:

Ecs: 云原生
Machine: 物理机

Config.description_en: The parameter settings of the instance. For more information, see [Parameter settings]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/43885.html）
Config.description_zh: 实例的参数设置情况，详情请参见[参数设置]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/43885.html）

ConnectionDomain.description_en:
The internal network connection endpoint of the instance.
<notice>After the network connectivity endpoint is modified or a new network connectivity endpoint is applied for, this field cannot provide the actual network status of the instance. Call the DescribeDBInstanceNetInfo operation to query the real-time network connectivity information of the instance.></notice>
ConnectionDomain.description_zh:
实例的内网连接地址。
<notice>在实例做过修改、申请新的网络连接地址的之后该字段无法提供实例实际网络状态信息，请使用 DescribeDBInstanceNetInfo  API 查询实例实时的对外网络连接信息。></notice>

ConnectionMode.description_en:
The access mode of the instance. Valid values:
Standard: standard access mode.
Safe: database proxy mode.

This parameter is deprecated. Call the DescribeDBInstanceNetInfo operation instead
ConnectionMode.description_zh:
实例的访问模式，返回值：
Standard：标准访问模式。
Safe：数据库代理模式。

已废弃，请使用Describedbinstancenetinfo代替查询

Connections.description_en: The maximum number of connections supported by the instance

CreateTime.description_en: The time when the instance was created

DestroyTime.description_en: The time when the instance was destroyed

EditionType.description_en:
The edition of the instance. Valid values:
Community: Community Edition.
Enterprise: Enterprise Edition
EditionType.description_zh:
实例类型，取值：
Community：社区版。
Enterprise：企业版

EndTime.description_en: The time when the subscription instance expires
EndTime.description_zh: 包年包月实例到期时间

EngineVersion.description_en: The Redis-compatible version of the instance

GlobalInstanceId.description_en:
The instance ID of the distributed instance.
This parameter is returned only when the instance is a child instance of a distributed instance
GlobalInstanceId.description_zh:
分布式实例ID。
当实例为分布式实例中的子实例时，才会返回该参数

HasRenewChangeOrder.description_en:
Indicates whether the instance has an unpaid renewal with specification change order. Valid values:
true: The instance has an unpaid order.
false: The instance does not have an unpaid order
HasRenewChangeOrder.description_zh:
是否有未生效的续费变配订单，返回值：
true：是。
false：否

InstanceClass.description_en: The instance type of the instance

InstanceStatus.description_en:
The instance status. Valid values:
Normal: The instance is normal.
Creating: The instance is being created.
Changing: The instance is being modified.
Inactive: The instance is disabled.
Flushing: The instance is being flushed.
Released: The instance is released.
Transforming: The instance is being transformed.
Unavailable: The instance is unavailable.
Error: The instance failed to be created.
Migrating: The instance is being migrated.
BackupRecovering: The instance is being restored from a backup.
MinorVersionUpgrading: A minor version update is in progress.
NetworkModifying: The network is being modified.
SSLModifying: SSL is being modified.
MajorVersionUpgrading: A major engine version upgrade is in progress. The instance can be accessed normally
InstanceStatus.description_zh:
实例状态，返回值：
Normal：正常。
Creating：创建中。
Changing：修改中。
Inactive：被禁用。
Flushing：清除中。
Released：已释放。
Transforming：转换中。
Unavailable：服务停止。
Error：创建失败。
Migrating：迁移中。
BackupRecovering：备份恢复中。
MinorVersionUpgrading：小版本升级中。
NetworkModifying：网络变更中。
SSLModifying：SSL变更中。
MajorVersionUpgrading：大版本升级中，可正常访问

The instance type. Valid values:
Tair
Redis
Memcache

实例类型，返回值：
Tair。
Redis。
Memcache

false: The instance is not managed by ApsaraDB RDS
IsRds.description_zh:
是否属RDS管控，返回值：
true：是。
false：否

The network type of the instance. Valid values:
CLASSIC: classic network.
VPC: VPC
NetworkType.description_zh:
网络类型，返回值：
CLASSIC：经典网络。
VPC：专有网络

NodeType.description_en:
The node type. Valid values:
double: dual-replica.
single: single-replica (discontinued).
MASTER_SLAVE: high availability (dual-replica).
STAND_ALONE: single-replica
NodeType.description_zh:
节点类型，返回值：
double：双副本。
single：单副本（已下线）。
MASTER_SLAVE：高可用（双副本）。
STAND_ALONE：单副本

PackageType.description_en:
The plan type. Valid values:
standard: standard plan.
customized: custom plan
PackageType.description_zh:
套餐类型，返回值：
standard：标准套餐。
customized：定制套餐

Port.description_en:
The service port of the instance.
<notice>After the port of the network connectivity endpoint is modified, this field cannot provide the actual network status of the instance. Call the DescribeDBInstanceNetInfo operation to query the real-time network connectivity information of the instance.></notice>
Port.description_zh:
实例的服务端口。
<notice>在实例做过修改网络连接地址的端口之后该字段无法提供实例实际网络状态信息，请使用 DescribeDBInstanceNetInfo  API 查询实例实时的对外网络连接信息。></notice>

PrivateIp.description_en:
The private IP address of the instance in the VPC.
This parameter is not returned if the network type of the instance is classic network
PrivateIp.description_zh:
专有网络IP地址。
实例的网络类型为经典网络时，不会返回本参数

ReadOnlyCount.description_en:
The number of read-only nodes in the primary zone.
The ReadOnlyCount and SlaveReadOnlyCount parameters apply only to cloud-native instances with read/write splitting enabled. If the instance uses the cluster architecture, these parameters indicate the number of read-only nodes per shard in the primary and secondary zones, respectively
ReadOnlyCount.description_zh:
主可用区的只读节点数（个）。
ReadOnlyCount与SlaveReadOnlyCount参数仅适用于云原生版、开启读写分离的实例。如果实例为集群架构，则上述参数分别表示单分片的（主、备可用区）只读节点数量

ReplacateId.description_en: The logical ID of the active geo-redundancy instance

ReplicaCount.description_en:
The number of replica nodes in the primary zone.
The ReplicaCount and SlaveReplicaCount parameters apply only to cloud-native instances. If the instance uses the cluster architecture, these parameters indicate the number of replica nodes per shard in the primary and secondary zones, respectively
ReplicaCount.description_zh:
主可用区的备节点数（个）。
ReplicaCount与SlaveReplicaCount参数仅适用于云原生版实例。如果实例为集群架构，则上述参数分别表示单分片的（主、备可用区）备节点数

ResourceGroupId.description_en: The ID of the resource group to which the instance belongs

SecondaryZoneId.description_en:
The ID of the secondary zone.
If the ZoneId parameter already returns a multi-zone value, such as "cn-hangzhou-MAZ10(h,i)", this parameter does not return the secondary zone ID
SecondaryZoneId.description_zh:
备可用区ID。
若ZoneId参数已返回多可用区，例如"cn-hangzhou-MAZ10(h,i)"，本参数将不返回备可用区ID

ShardClass.description_en:
The node specifications of the data shard. For details, see [Specification lookup]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/26350.html）.
The overall performance of a cluster instance is calculated as follows: shard node specification (ShardClass) × number of shards (ShardCount)
ShardClass.description_zh:
数据分片节点规格，规格详情请参见[规格查询导航]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/26350.html）。
集群架构实例的整体性能为：分片节点规格（ShardClass） * 分片数（ShardCount）

ShardCount.description_en:
The number of data shards in the cluster.
This parameter is returned only for cloud-native cluster instances or read/write splitting instances
ShardCount.description_zh:
集群的数据节点数。
云原生版集群或读写分离架构实例才会返回本参数

SlaveReadOnlyCount.description_en: The number of read-only nodes in the secondary zone
SlaveReadOnlyCount.description_zh: 备可用区的只读节点数（个）

SlaveReplicaCount.description_en: The number of replica nodes in the secondary zone
SlaveReplicaCount.description_zh: 备可用区的备节点数（个）

UserName.description_en: The username used for the connection. By default, a username named after the instance ID is included
UserName.description_zh: 连接使用的用户名，默认包含有一个以实例ID命名的用户名

VpcId.description_en: The ID of the virtual private cloud (VPC)

PageNumber.description_en: The page number of the instance list

PageSize.description_en: The number of entries per page that was specified in the request
PageSize.description_zh: 输入时设置的每页行数
